name: Brig Gen Charles E. Yeager Award (miniature medal body)
size_basis: Body width 0.625 in = the standard ribbon width for this size (1 3/8 in full, 5/8 in miniature; DoDM 1348.33 as relayed by the coordination chat, not verified locally); proportions from the McChord rasters (disc = ribbon width); CAPR 39-3 gives no medal dimensions. Height is the constructed body plus suspension ring. The drawing keeps the width and the box; it is built from the photograph's own measured proportions (body scale 296.4 px per in, body width 0.625 in).
ribbon_attach_note: ribbon_attach is the bail axis at the box top (the box cuts the ring away) (upright body, hang angle -0.87 deg removed); compose.js hangs it at the drape's V point

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is where the ribbon meets the suspension loop.

generator: artwork-samples/assets/medals-work/design/yeager.js (parameters in inches) over lib.js, common.js, font.js, emit.js; gates: kitA.js; node makeA.js yeager --write

measured.photo: aeroeducation.jpeg (Vanguard photograph, 600 x 600 px, reference only)

frame.note: body width 0.625 in (the spec width) sets the scale; every length below is inches in the medal frame (origin = disc centre, +y down, UPRIGHT: the photograph is rotated by the measured hang angle into this frame)

measured.hang_angle_note: measured from the bail axis against the disc centre in the photograph (frame.js); the drawing hangs upright (bail and disc axis vertical)
not_measurable: IDENTITY: the Vanguard photograph aeroeducation.jpeg is the CAP Aerospace Education (Air Force Auxiliary / Aerospace Education) miniature medal, NOT the Brig Gen Charles E. Yeager Award; assets/medals-work/NO_REFERENCE.md records that Vanguard sells only a RIBBON for the Yeager award, and no Yeager medal photograph exists in the repository (photomap.json has no Yeager entry; the composite Civil_Air_Patrol_Awards_and_Decorations.jpg is a uniform photograph without a legible medal). This body is therefore the Aerospace Education medal, modelled because it is the only measurable CAP medal body for this asset id; whether the real Yeager medal looks like this is UNCONFIRMED.
The cast silver surface: soft shading inside the emblem triangle and legs and the engraving grain are not drawn (flat tones).

The lamp is read from a ~1 px wide silhouette: the small stub above the saucer and the notch at the right end of the crossbar are approximate; the thin light slit between the A and the spout is not drawn (the figure parts simply do not touch).
Suspension ring: seen as three fine parallel wires in the photograph; drawn as one circle of the combined width.

palette.ramp: ramp measured from the reference metal (ramp.js)

gates.silhouette_iou: >= 0.95 (shipped upright miniature vs the photograph body mask rotated into the upright frame)
gates.landmarks: every named feature centroid within 0.02 in of the reference
gates.edge_recall: lit-metal outline recall >= 0.80 within 0.012 in (0.006 in reported)
gates.ribbon_attach: top centre of the ring (bail axis at the box top where the box cuts the ring)

ribbon_attach_units.basis: bail axis at the box top (the box cuts the ring away)

fidelity.note: Redrawn as clean parametric vector (LIVE13-ART 25/26): every object (disc, rim, lettering, emblem parts, bail, ring) is modelled as what it is, from measured parameters, not traced; flat tones with a lit and a shadow edge. Replaces the traced body (LIVE13-ART 20).

fit_score.note: IoU of the shipped upright miniature against the photograph body mask rotated into the upright frame (design/kitA.js)

notes: Designed miniature medal body (LIVE13-ART 26). Measured from aeroeducation.jpeg (reference only, never shipped). Reference check: aeroeducation.jpeg shows the CAP Aerospace Education miniature medal (lettering AIR FORCE AUXILIARY / AEROSPACE EDUCATION, lamp emblem on an A triangle, three stars), NOT the Yeager award: the identity of this asset id is unconfirmed. Hang angle -0.87 deg of the photograph removed: the body hangs upright.
